$schema.description: Where this payload's schema is published.

biopixi.description: The biopixi release that produced the results.

profile.description: The grading profile the levels are defined by.

results.description: One entry per directory given, in the order they were given.

GradeReport.description:
The `biopixi grade --json` payload.

The envelope carries the versions a consumer needs to interpret `results`: `profile` is the grading profile the levels are defined by, `biopixi` is the release that produced them.

projectRoot.description: The graded directory, absolute and symlink-resolved.

sourceRoot.description: The absolute, symlink-resolved directory bounding local path dependencies. Defaults to the project root; a caller grading a collection may widen it to any ancestor. Recorded on every result because it is a property of the invocation, not of the project.

conformant.description: Whether the manifest is inside profile v0. Everything below is unanswerable when false.

evidenceState.description: Whether a solve backs the result. Null when the manifest never got as far as being solved.

level.description: How far the environment travels, 1–4. Null unless `evidenceState` is `DEFINITIVE`.

label.description: The level, evidence state, or `L0`, as one token for display.

reasons.description: Why the result is what it is, most specific first.

lints.description: Portability concerns that did not change the result.

nextActions.description: What to do to move the result up, in the order it would have to be done.

target.description: The `name=version` set a container claim would be built from.

cap.description: What holds the environment at this level. Absent at L4, where nothing does.

publication.description: The container this environment can be published as, and how that was arrived at.

snapshot.description: Provenance of the vendored metadata behind `publication`, when any was consulted.

pathDependencies.description: Every conformant local path dependency the manifest reaches, including those reached through another path dependency. Absent when the manifest declares none, which is the common case.

directory.description: As supplied on the command line, so a caller can match results back to its own arguments.

GradeReportEntry.description: One graded directory: the path as the caller wrote it, plus everything grading decided.

EvidenceState.description: Whether there is a solve biopixi can stand behind. Separate from readiness: a level is only meaningful when the evidence is `DEFINITIVE`.

package.description: The dependency name, as the manifest and the lock both spell it.

version.description: The locked version, absent only when the lock records none.

channel.description: The channel it resolved from, or null when it was built from source.

artifact.description: The resolved artifact URL, or the path it is built from.

Cap.description: The dependency and resolved artifact holding a platform below L4.

uri.description: The container image this environment corresponds to.

verified.description: Whether a registry was reached and the image found there. False while grading is offline.

basis.description: How the URI was arrived at, so an unverified claim can be judged rather than trusted.

Publication.description: A container claim and the basis for it. `verified` stays false while grading is offline: naming an image is not the same as reaching a registry and finding it there.

file.description: The vendored copy's filename inside this package.

source.description: The upstream repository it was taken from.

revision.description: The exact upstream commit vendored, or null if it was not recorded.

revisionDate.description: The date of that commit, ISO 8601.

fetched.description: The date the copy was taken, ISO 8601.

sha1.description: SHA-1 of the vendored copy, so the claim stays checkable offline.

MetadataSnapshot.description: Provenance of the vendored public metadata a claim rests on.

name.description: The dependency name, as the manifest that declares it spells it.

declared.description: The path as declared, relative to the manifest that declares it.

resolved.description: The directory it points at, absolute and symlink-resolved.

version.description: The concrete version its package manifest declares.

recipe.description: The recipe file backing it, relative to the project root.

PathDependency.description: A local path dependency that satisfies the profile, recorded so a result can be audited.
